bio: This restaurant lives up to its name: Wurzel, meaning root, signifies a dedication to the local terroir, Werk, meaning craft, highlights a commitment to artisanal cooking techniques – chef-patron Benjamin Bendzko puts both into practice in his market-fresh cuisine. Exceptional and almost exclusively regional ingredients are used to create flavoursome and pleasingly down-to-earth dishes. Two buildings, built in 1875 as a farmstead, now house a guesthouse (with a café at weekends) and this restaurant, whose rustic charm and pretty decor make for a cosy atmosphere. In summer, the garden terrace is the place to be....
